descentmtb.configuration.title: Descent MTB settings
descentmtb.config.manual_assist.tooltip: Leaning back lifts the front wheel and holds the balance point.
descentmtb.pump.hint: Sneak-air: valve; click parked bike: inflate; sneak-click: bleed.
descentmtb.overlay.hint: Click: add to the shaped surface • Shift: remove
descentmtb.shaping.hint.place: Place it, then shape it with the Trail Shaper
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_quarter: Rises ¼ block away from you, continuing the block behind
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_half: Rises ½ block away from you, continuing the block behind
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_full: Rises a full block away from you, continuing the block behind
descentmtb.shape.desc.drop_half: Falls ½ block away from you, starting at the lip behind
descentmtb.shape.desc.bank_left_half: Slopes ½ block up towards your left
descentmtb.shape.desc.bank_right_half: Slopes ½ block up towards your right
descentmtb.shape.desc.bank_left_full: Slopes a full block up towards your left
descentmtb.shape.desc.bank_right_full: Slopes a full block up towards your right
descentmtb.shape.desc.corner_bank: The corner you aim at rises ½ block
descentmtb.shape.desc.auto: Moves the corner, edge or block you aim at by 1/16
descentmtb.shape.desc.flatten: Levels the block to its average height
descentmtb.shape.desc.reset: Back to a full, flat block
descentmtb.shape.title: TRAIL SHAPER
descentmtb.shape.tooltip: Right-click: shape one block • hold G: modes • Z: undo
descentmtb.shape.hud.hint.0: [%s] menu • Shift + wheel: mode • Shift + click: rise towards you
descentmtb.shape.hud.hint.1: [%s] menu • Shift + wheel: mode • click: shape the block
descentmtb.shape.hud.hint.2: [%s] menu • click: +1/16 • Shift + click: -1/16 • Shift + wheel: mode
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_make: Turns a block into a kicker ramp that looks like it (Shift: faces you)
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_steepness: Raises the end of the ramp by 2/16 (Shift: lowers it)
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_start: Raises the start of the ramp by 2/16 (Shift: lowers it)
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_profile: Straight, kicker, roller (Shift: the other way round)
descentmtb.shape.desc.ramp_link: Click the first ramp, then another one in line: the run becomes one slope
descentmtb.shape.hud.hint.3: [%s] menu • click: apply • Shift + click: reverse • Shift + wheel: mode
descentmtb.ramp_tune.cannot_make: This block cannot become a ramp
descentmtb.shape.desc.copy: Click two corners, then every right-click pastes the copy
descentmtb.shape.hud.hint.copy: [%s] menu • click: corner / paste • Shift + block: new selection • Shift + air: turn 90°
descentmtb.copy.unsupported: Chests and other blocks with data cannot be copied
descentmtb.shape.desc.berm_build: Click entry, apex and exit: the berm is built through them
descentmtb.shape.hud.hint.berm_build: [%s] menu • click: point • Shift + click: clear • Shift + wheel: steepness • Ctrl + Shift + wheel: width
descentmtb.berm.straight: The three points are almost in a line - put the apex to the side
descentmtb.berm.too_close: The points are too close together
descentmtb.berm.too_long: The berm is too long (at most %s m)
